title: Verify and decide priority inheritance for add --under (children of a p1 parent appear as p1)
outcome: Verify and decide priority inheritance for add --under (children of a p1 parent appear as p1)
acceptance: When work is created through CLI/MCP add --under, core decompose or atomic plan, omitted priority makes a required child inherit its parent's priority and an optional child use the project default priority; an explicit priority wins. Existing items retain their stored priority. MCP description and schema, CLI help and docs describe the same rule, and tests cover each path (add, decompose, plan) with required inheritance, optional defaulting and explicit override using a parent priority different from the project default.
